HOW TO PLAY

←↑↓→WASDMove and navigate menus
EnterSpaceZConfirm, talk, advance dialogue
EscXGo back or close
HOpen the Type & Disc guide in-game (matchups, discs, modules)
ITabOpen the Pack

TOUCHOn phones and tablets, an on-screen D-pad plus A (confirm), B (back) and PACK buttons appear. Tap any menu item directly.

Every menu also works with the mouse or by tapping. Touch controls appear automatically on mobile.

FEATURES

109 FAMILIES · 327 FORMS

Every family evolves through three named stages — Voltling → Voltrix → Teslarch, Qubit → Qubiton → Quantarch. The Sci-Database logs them all, searchable and filterable.

ALL-NEW INDIVIDUAL SPRITES

654 hand-separated artworks: a unique front and a true rear view for every form — rear sprites are drawn from behind, never mirrored. Clean cutouts, crisp at any size.

STAGE-AWARE BATTLE SIZING

Combat scales each creature from its actual body, not a flat resize: first stages read small, finals tower — and floating lines hover above the battlefield with their shadows left behind.

CANONICAL NAMES, SAFE SAVES

Forms carry their real names everywhere — battles, Sci-Database, evolution announcements ("Florabot evolved into Floravine!"). Old saves migrate automatically and player nicknames are always preserved.

COLLECT & BATTLE

Turn-based fights with eighteen types, techniques, capture modules, held cells and XP growth across all 327 forms.

EXPLORE RIVEN TOWN

Shops, eight interiors, beaches and a cast of characters to meet — plus the Corrupt Bandits storyline beyond it.

SCI-DATABASE

Log every machine you meet, manage your party, bag and held items across eight storage boxes.

PLAYS ANYWHERE

Python & Pygame compiled to WebAssembly (pygbag): keyboard, mouse or touch, fullscreen on phones, progress saved in the browser.
